_meta.render: pdftoppm -jpeg -r 110 (pages 3-4 rendered at -r 150 to confirm page order)
_meta.notes: The cover page of this copy is the '[Officeholders - Year-End]' variant of the 2014 form that carries NO candidate-name / party / office-sought / district fields at all - only the Type of Report block and the verification block. The candidate name is therefore taken from the Report Verification line ('Brett Helsten'); party, office_sought and district_number are null because those fields do not exist on this page. Despite the '[Officeholders - Year-End]' title the JUNE 17 interim box is checked and the Year-End box is NOT - the form face is recorded. Neither amendment box is checked. Summary Page is page 2 (Column B labelled 'Year to Date'); page 3 is Itemized Contributions, page 4 Itemized Expenditures (one line, Speak by Design, campaign post cards, 499.50). Line 1 Column A writes cents as a raised superscript ('500' with superscript '00'). Line 2 Column B (835.36) is faint in the scan. Arithmetic checks: 123.28 + 500.00 = 623.28 and 623.28 - 499.50 = 123.78.
